entities.name: API 上下文图谱 (context graph)
entities.how_described: 本集的核心产物：Postman 为其工程架构构建的集中上下文图层，盘点每个微服务、每个端点直至具体代码行，每个数据点都必须锚定在代码或生产遥测这条硬事实上，并且必须持续同步，否则结果出错、开发者信任崩塌。

evidence.quote: So I'm going to be using our real engineering use cases and workflows on top of our coding agent experiences and what we learned from it and how we have been improving the experience and the effectiveness of our coding agents with API context graph.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So we went out to start building an API context graph for what Postman's engineering architecture looks like.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We gave all of this data and we indexed all of this data using LLM to produce a centralized and effective context graph layer.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But one key principle that we had in mind always was every single data point that landed on the context graph always had to be grounded down in a hard truth.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: With this in place, we set out on a journey to populate our context graph, and this is a snapshot of what our engineering architecture kind of looks like.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So now that we have the context graph, when we start looking at how do we measure what does it add in terms of improvements to the coding agents?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: To run the validations, we were able to get the Postman's AI agent connected to the API context graph, and we were able to validate all of these against the Postman AI agent as well.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We also took the same context graph and we made it available as a skill and also compared that against the generic coding agent, in this case, Claude Code.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: With the context graph, the agents go really well as compared to pure code search, where the agents don't do really well.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And the thing that helped in this case is, first of all, the context graph having an awareness of every single consumer of an API.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So this is one scenario where we see the context graph really shine well, and you can see that Postman Agent not only does really well in terms of the quality of the output, but also it's able to do it with almost like half or even one third when compared to your code search.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So the context graph is not only important to populate, but it's equally important that you keep it up to date, and any delays in syncing your context graph with the ground truth creates gap in the result.

evidence.quote: So these use cases were clear for us to do a before and after comparison with the context graph and without the context graph.
